headline: CHC @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.76 at SFG 3.92, with a projected total of 7.68. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: CHC moved -1.16 runs while SFG moved +0.04, changing the projected margin by -1.19 runs. The projected total fell -1.12, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Luis Arraez, Pete Crow-Armstrong, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Rafael Devers because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
